test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 15 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**A sentence has been given with a blank to be filled with an appropriate option. Choose the correct alternative**

There is definitely _________ he is not telling me.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Something**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is in the present continuous tense.
 
• The blank requires a noun to complete the sentence.
 
• The word "**definitely**" implies that the speaker is sure of something.
 
• So, the word "**something**" fits the context as it implies that there is some information that the person is not sharing.
 
• **Something **means an object, situation, quality, or action that is not exactly known or stated. (कोई वस्तु, स्थिति, गुणवत्ता या क्रिया जो ठीक-ठीक ज्ञात या बताई गई न हो)

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

**Complete sentence:** *There is definitely something __he is not telling me.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** Let us look at the other options.

 
• **Everything **(सब कुछ), This option implies that the person is not sharing any information at all, which does not fit the context of the sentence.
 
• **Somebody **(कोई व्यक्ति), This option implies that the person is hiding someone, which does not fit the context of the sentence.
 
• **Anything **(कुछ भी), This option is too broad and does not convey a specific meaning in the context of the sentence.

189:T973,

The correct answer is: **Detested**
